caller_is_owner.meaning: the caller of increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() is the contract owner

mev_monitors_increase_liquidity.meaning: an MEV bot monitors the mempool for increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() calls

transaction_held_until_unfavorable.meaning: the MEV bot holds the transaction until market conditions are unfavorable

stale_pricing_execution_occurs.meaning: the held transaction executes with stale pricing parameters after being held until market conditions are unfavorable
stale_pricing_execution_occurs.checkpoint: at execution of the held transaction

assumptions: The liquidity-increase transaction is submitted by the owner through increaseLiquidityCurrentRange() and is observed by the MEV bot in the mempool.
The held transaction is the same transaction that later executes; no cancellation or replacement is reported.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a concrete caller-provided deadline value or the block.timestamp at which the held transaction executes, so the expiry comparison cannot be numerically bound; the qualitative stale-pricing execution is used.
Report does not establish a specific prior market state or price movement that makes the held transaction unfavorable.

limitations: Stale-pricing execution and MEV profit are described as potential; no concrete observed transaction or quantified loss is supplied.
The deadline-expiry relation is represented qualitatively because no concrete deadline or timestamp values are reported.
Only the stale_pricing_executes impact is formalized; indefinite_execution and mev_profit are handled in separate passes.
